import { type JsonNumber } from '@omne-harness-lite/content-blocks';
export declare function isJsonInteger(value: unknown): value is JsonNumber;
export declare function compareNumbers(left: JsonNumber, right: JsonNumber): -1 | 0 | 1;
export declare function isPositiveInteger(value: unknown): value is JsonNumber;
export declare function inRange(value: unknown, minimum: number, maximum: number, openMinimum?: boolean): boolean;
